notes: Read SKILL.md (171 lines) in full; it is the only file in source. Guidance and Rust sample code for the official azure_security_keyvault_secrets crate: set/get/update/delete secrets, paginated listing, error handling, and RBAC roles.

Tells the agent to add crates with `cargo add` (SKILL.md:28, and Best Practice 1 at SKILL.md:156 says always use cargo add rather than editing Cargo.toml), which downloads from crates.io and edits the user's manifest; sample code authenticates with the developer's real Azure identity (DeveloperToolsCredential) against a live vault. Medium because of the package install and live-credential use; acceptable because crates are the official azure-sdk publisher's, it warns against unofficial crates (SKILL.md:23), and all vault operations act only on the user's own vault as part of their own task.

Sample code prints secret values to stdout (SKILL.md:61, 138) and shows delete_secret (SKILL.md:117) with no confirmation step; these are examples for the user's own program, not agent-run commands, but users should avoid logging real secret values. Optionally recommends `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` (SKILL.md:163). No external-file dependencies.
